resources.string: MIYORARE 1.3.0
Safer restore, clearer collections, and a smoother way to browse.
Safer Restore Destinations
Choose Normal or Private and keep the two spaces separate.
Mihon backups can now be restored directly to Normal Favourites or Private Favourites. Compatible category order, reading progress, history, and bookmarks are preserved more consistently.
Settings → Backup & Restore
Choose a Mihon backup, start Restore, then select the collection destination you want.
Stronger Normal / Private Separation
Collection state stays with the destination you choose.
Normal and Private handling is more consistent across restored collections, destination-aware Local shelves, and saved-page destinations, reducing the chance of state crossing between the two spaces.
Favourites, Local, and saved-page destinations
Use Normal or Private as usual; Miyorare keeps supported collection state scoped to the active destination.
More Reliable Miyorare Source Packs
Safer updates and stronger compatibility checks.
Source Pack update and compatibility handling has been strengthened, with additional validation before pack-related changes are promoted to stable releases.
Settings → Sources → Miyorare Source Packs
Keep using and updating Miyorare Source Packs normally; compatibility checks now guard more of the update path.
Smoother Explore & Search
Find, refine, and continue searching with fewer interruptions.
Explore can search the extension list already on screen without forcing a reload, global search queries can be edited from results, and Suggestions visibility is remembered.
Explore and Global Search
Use Explore search to filter the visible extension list, or tap the query on global search results to edit and search again.
More Improvements
🔧 Category sorting, collection destination handling, manga editing, and large Favourites dialogs received additional fixes and refinements.
🛡️ Release validation now covers more unit, compile, compatibility, and runtime checks to help keep stable builds safer.
